h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bharatpur

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bharatpur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bharatpur

c: Bharatpur, in eastern Rajasthan, is known for the Keoladeo bird sanctuary, and visitors who come for the wetlands keep its hotels and resorts busy in the winter months. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bharatpur to those hotels and resorts, and also to schools, colleges, municipal gardens and residential colonies. The machines are made at our Vasai factory, about 990 km away, and sent by road.

A resort near a sanctuary needs a fitness corner that sits quietly in a green setting. We roto-mould parts in more than 15 colour shades, so you can choose greens, browns or greys that suit your garden in place of bright orange. For a town park the priority is different: plenty of stations, simple to use, and solid enough for daily public use. Both kinds of site face the same weather, with very hot summers, a short monsoon and cool winter mornings.

items.q: Can you match the machine colours to our resort?
items.a: Yes. We have more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades. Tell us your preferred colours when you send the site photos and we will show them on the quote.

items.q: Do you supply municipal gardens in Bharatpur as well?
items.a: Yes. For a public garden we suggest sturdier, grouted machines and a layout with clear walking space between stations. Send us the garden size and we will propose a set.

items.q: What warranty comes with outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry 3 years against manufacturing defects. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year, as long as the machines are installed and maintained as we advise.
